capabilities: Show large card titles in Overview Mode when zoomed out
Build mind maps with Tab, Enter, and arrow-key shortcuts
Style nodes and edges with flowchart shapes, borders, and arrows
Integrate canvas files into graph view, backlinks, and outgoing links
Export canvases to PNG or SVG
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later. Mindmap rearrangement does not yet support canvases containing portals.
intentEvidence: Canvas Enhance continues development with a rename, refactoring, and new features.
motivation: The author states Obsidian Canvas 'leaves gaps' and built the plugin to fill them without changing the native experience.
problem: Obsidian Canvas nodes become unreadable when zoomed out, lack keyboard-driven mind mapping and rich node/edge styles, and .canvas files stay outside the graph view and backlinks.

relations.evidence: Based on Advanced Canvas by Developer-Mike. Canvas Enhance continues development with a rename, refactoring, and new features.

summary: Canvas enhancement suite that adds zoomed-out overview mode, keyboard mind mapping, flowchart node styles, portals, and canvas metadata integration.
